html:
SMTO-AUT-0022 — More than one Google account could do this

GUID: bcc98c83-ee52-5c08-8b09-602b4c1a3e86
Slug: google-account-ambiguous
Domain: AUT · Subsystem: google-workspace

What happened

  • You have several connected Google accounts that could handle this request, and SMTO won't guess which one to act as. Nothing was done with any of them.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to list your connected Google accounts to see which email addresses are connected. The choice is between accounts that are already connected, so you need to see them first.
  2. Send your request again and name the account, for example by typing @ in the message box and picking that Google account. Pointing to one account removes the doubt, so SMTO acts only as the account you chose.
  3. Double-check the email address before you send, especially for requests that send, change or delete things. SMTO will act as whichever account you pick, so the wrong choice would affect the wrong mailbox, calendar or Drive.

What success looks like

  • Your request runs as the Google account you chose, without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send it to the person who manages SMTO. Don't disconnect your other Google accounts just to avoid choosing; other tasks may use them.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Google account resolution found several eligible accounts and no single explicit or accepted account selection.

What this means

  • Account resolution found multiple eligible records without one explicit accepted selection. Authorization establishes a particular connection, account and scope. It neither expands operation permissions nor proves the outcome of a request already dispatched.

Why this can happen

  • Account resolution found multiple eligible records without one explicit accepted selection.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare the eligible account summaries and the task's accepted account references.

How to fix it

  • Pass the intended account_ref from the eligible account summaries in the error details, or accept exactly one google_account parameter reference in the prompt. resolve_account refuses to pick by storage order when more than one account satisfies the required features.
  • Select the intended account_ref from the eligible Google account summaries.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm account identity and required features before retrying.

How to verify the fix

  • One explicitly intended eligible account resolves for the operation.

What not to do

  • Do not expose client secrets, tokens, codes or PKCE verifiers.
  • Do not switch accounts or repeat uncertain mutations automatically.

Technical notes

  • Authorization establishes a particular connection, account and scope. It neither expands operation permissions nor proves the outcome of a request already dispatched.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
